source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

items.name: Site Bound
items.text: A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to it rather than a location.

items.name: Rejuvenation
items.text: If he's destroyed, he rejuvenates in 2d4 days unless the Bastardhall Curse is lifted.

items.name: Blasphemous Decree
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect Eragayl points out a creature he can see within 60 feet with his blade, proclaiming them to be heretics deserving of death. The target creature's faith quakes and strains under the decree, and the target creature must attempt a DC 29 Will save save with the following effects. Worshippers of Shelyn gain a +2 status bonus to this saving throw. This ability replaces the ghost mage's arcane innate spells.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected. If the creature is a worshipper of Shelyn, Eragayl is Stunned 3.

Success The creature takes 2d8 mental damage.

Failure The creature takes 4d8 mental damage. If the creature can cast divine spells, it's Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes 8d8 mental damage. If the creature can cast divine spells, it is stupefied 1 for 1 round and can't cast divine spells for 1 round.

items.name: Frightful Moan
items.text: The ghost laments its fate, forcing each living creature within 30 feet to attempt a DC 29 Will save save. On a failure, a creature becomes Frightened 2 (or Frightened 3 on a critical failure). On a success, a creature is temporarily immune to this ghost's frightful moan for 1 minute.

items.name: Reminders of Life
items.text: Eragayl is shocked if anyone addresses him by the nickname his wife Tasifinie had for him: "tiger." The first time someone does so in a round, Eragayl must attempt a DC 35 Will save save to avoid becoming Slowed 1 for 1 round by the distraction. If the person who used this name on him openly wields Fearcutter, his memories usurp his nature automatically; he shrieks in rage and turns his wrath on Irrokcis instead, cursing his son's name as he uses a combination of Blasphemous Decrees and Telekinetic Assault on the lich for the rest of the combat.

items.name: Telekinetic Assault
items.text: The ghost cries out in pain and anguish as small objects and debris fly about in a 30-foot emanation. Creatures in this area take 6d6 bludgeoning damage, subject to a DC 29 basic Reflex save save.
